comment: Third-party virtual display drivers used only to reproduce the multi-display freeze (Phase 1). Pinned by SHA-256; Run-VddRepro.ps1 refuses files that do not match. Packages are unpacked into <project>\cache\vdd-repro by Get-VddPackages.ps1.

drivers.name: parsec
drivers.title: Parsec Virtual Display Adapter 0.45.0.0
drivers.signer: Microsoft Windows Hardware Compatibility Publisher (WHQL); installs without extra trust

drivers.name: sudovda
drivers.title: SudoVDA 1.10.9.289 (from Apollo 0.4.6)
drivers.signer: self-signed CN=sudovda@su.mk (code signing only, not a CA); trusted in Root + TrustedPublisher for the run, as Apollo's installer does, then removed

drivers.name: mtt
drivers.title: MTT Virtual Display Driver 11.30.4.434 (release 25.7.23, driver-only package; predates the PR #482 swap-chain fix)
drivers.signer: SignPath Foundation (publicly trusted Authenticode); its leaf certificate goes into TrustedPublisher for the run so the install is silent, then removed
